text:
rik: hi all, first-day snag. I accepted the org invite but can't access a few repos (403). GitHub web shows "You must authorize SAML SSO" and CLI says permission denied. Accepted with rik.personal@example.com originally, then got a second invite to rik@redwood.com. any ideas?
zainab: welcome! quick Q: which username does `ssh -T git@github.com` show? and are you trying SSH or HTTPS?
rik: `ssh -T git@github.com` -> `Hi rikold! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.` i'm using SSH.
it-sre: that output means the SSH key you're presenting is attached to your personal account. run `ssh-add -l` to see which keys agent is offering. Also check Profile -> Organizations -> Redwood Inference for an "Authorize" SSO button.
rik: `ssh-add -l` shows a single key. i clicked the org card and it only says "You are a member" (no authorize button). repo pages still 403.
scim-bot: SCIM: provisioning event for rik@redwood.com -> teams: ml-platform (2026-03-10T09:10:00Z).
mira: sometimes SCIM maps by email_verified or external_id; if you had a different primary email on GH it can get mapped but not assigned teams. zainab, can you check the provisioning log?
zainab: checked SCIM logs: initial provision mapped the account based on email rik.personal@example.com then we later invited rik@redwood.com causing two linked identities. The account that holds the SSH key (rikold) wasn't the one that got teams. i'm going to reprovision and merge the identities so the key maps to the provisioned user.
rik: any way I can verify locally while you re-sync?
it-sre: after reprovision try `gh api /user -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json"` to confirm the authenticated user and `gh auth status` to ensure the CLI is using the right account. Also re-add your work SSH key to your GitHub profile (recommended to generate a new key per job).
scim-bot: SCIM: reprovision triggered for rik@redwood.com (merge alt email rik.personal@example.com) -> job queued.
zainab: done the merge on our side. rik, can you log out of GitHub in the browser, clear cookies or use incognito, then `gh auth login --web` and pick rik@redwood.com?
rik: logged out and re-authenticated with `gh auth login --web` as rik@redwood.com. `ssh -T git@github.com` now -> `Hi rik! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.`
mira: great — that shows the SSH key is on the same account that SCIM provisioned. try cloning the repo again or `git push` if you had a branch.
rik: clone worked! pushed my initial branch too. :tada: thanks.
zainab: follow-ups: 1) ops will avoid sending invites to personal emails and we'll update SCIM to favor work_email and employee_id when available, 2) onboarding doc will tell new hires to authorize SSO and generate a new SSH key for work, and 3) add a quick checklist item to run `ssh-add -l`, `ssh -T git@github.com`, and `gh auth status` during first-hour setup.
it-sre: filed ONB-4271 to update the welcome doc and tweak SCIM mapping rules. welcome aboard @rik!
